data.name: ValidationErrorsOccurred
data.value: Some of the entered values are not valid, so nothing was saved. Check the messages next to each field, correct them and send the form again.

data.name: UnauthorizedDetail
data.value: You are not signed in, or your session has expired, so the action was not performed. Sign in again and repeat it.

data.name: ResourceNotFoundDetail
data.value: The item you asked for does not exist, or it was deleted. Reload the page and open it again from the list.

data.name: UnexpectedErrorOccurred
data.value: Something went wrong on the server and the action may not have been completed. Wait a minute and repeat it, and if the problem keeps happening, contact the administrator and mention the time it occurred.

data.name: BusinessRuleViolationDetail
data.value: The action is not possible in the current state of this item, so nothing was changed. Reload the page to see its current state and check that your entries fit it.

data.name: ConcurrencyConflictDetail
data.value: Someone else already saved a change to this record. Reload it and try again.

data.name: InvalidRequestBodyDetail
data.value: The server could not read the data sent with this request, for example because it is malformed, has a value of the wrong type or is too large. Reload the page and send it again, and if you call the API directly, check the JSON you send.

data.name: InvalidDecimalValue
data.value: The value '{0}' is not a valid number. Enter digits only, with a dot as the decimal separator, for example 12.50.

data.name: CsrfHeaderMissingDetail
data.value: This request must be sent from the panel itself. Reload the page and try again.

data.name: ForbiddenDetail
data.value: Your account does not have the permission this action needs, so it was not performed. Ask an administrator to grant the permission, or sign in with an account that has it.

data.name: InvalidFieldValue
data.value: This value could not be read in the expected format. Check what you entered and correct it.
